answers.trail_item_8: Not run yet; it is on our Sunday 10-18 list (journal/research/SUNDAY_TESTS.md item 8), on real option minute prices. We will send the result. Our current rule for every trailing variant: arm once the price reaches 2x entry (trail_after 1.0), then exit at max(entry, 60% of the peak price). That is 60% of the peak price, not 60% of the gain. answers.largest_gap_cap: No cap in realopt.json; gaps run from 2% to 26.9% (median 3.2%). Buckets over the full sample (211 trades, 2024 to 2026-09-14, 10% costs), avg per trade / without the best trade / win rate: 2-3% gap -44% / -50% / 24% (n 95); 3-4% -39% / -47% / 26% (n 54); 4-6% -10% / -25% / 34% (n 35); over 6% -61% / -72% / 19% (n 27). So the worst group is the >6% gaps (real news, the stock keeps falling); 4-6% is the least bad but still negative without its best trade. A 6% cap is a candidate, not an edge. These are full-sample numbers, not the 3-month regime check.
